text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm headed to the gym to pick up Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh, my entire body is throbbing with pain. This must be what Ryan meant by "screaming muscles."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, there's no time to rest. Next, I need to do fifty—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Yes, but I haven't met today's quota yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm working on the muscle training regimen Ryan gave me, you see. I must finish the entire thing, no matter what.
choice_data_list: But you've clearly already hit your limit.
But you've clearly already hit your limit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Naturally. After all, I specifically asked for a regimen that would push me beyond my limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If I'm unable to surpass the limit looming right before my eyes, I cannot possibly call myself a Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please don't try to stop me! This is all for the purpose of achieving victory! One… two… three…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Four… five… Hehe, the night wind is refreshing… and the hot spring was the perfect temperature. Just marvelous…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nearly time for the baseball game. This TV looks old, but… this is another pleasure of traveling. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I also secretly brought some treats with me, and there isn't anyone here to stop me. Hehe, now then…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hit that ball, Yu-ta-ka! Hit that ball, Yu-ta-kaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? I thought I just heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It would be nice if I could stay and relax here, but it doesn't look like I can anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: You were in the middle of a desperate workout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-is that so? I feel I've just woken up from the strangest dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In any case, I'm filled to the brim with strength. I think I may have surpassed my limits!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has indeed done just that. Mejiro McQueen is looking stronger than ever.
